parcel_summary.address: 2165 Sandy Pines Dr NE, Palm Bay FL 32905

permits.name: PUD Preliminary Development Plan (PDP)
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Planning & Zoning Division
permits.description: Required for any new development within a PUD. Shows building locations, density, open space, parking, circulation, landscaping. Must be consistent with approved PUD ordinance.

permits.name: PUD Final Development Plan (FDP)
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Planning & Zoning Division
permits.description: Detailed engineering drawings for construction. Must conform to approved PDP. Includes grading, drainage, utilities, landscaping details.
permits.review_body: Administrative (staff review) — if consistent with approved PDP

permits.name: Site Plan Approval
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Development Review
permits.description: Detailed site plan review for multifamily development. Covers setbacks, parking, landscaping, building placement, access, fire safety.

permits.name: Floodplain Development Permit
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Building Department
permits.code_section: Chapter 174 (Palm Bay Code — Floodplain & Stormwater Management)
permits.description: Required before any construction in Zone A SFHA. Must demonstrate compliance with FEMA NFIP regulations and Florida Building Code flood provisions.
prerequisites: Elevation plan showing all structures above BFE + 1 ft freeboard

permits.name: SJRWMD Environmental Resource Permit (ERP)
permits.agency: St. Johns River Water Management District
permits.description: Required for projects >1 acre affecting surface water, wetlands, or requiring stormwater management. Covers wetland impacts, stormwater design, water quality treatment.
permits.estimated_timeline: 3-6 months (60-90 day standard review + potential RAI)

permits.name: Section 404 Wetland Fill Permit (State-Assumed)
permits.description: Required if any wetland fill proposed. Joint application with SJRWMD ERP. Avoidance/minimization/mitigation sequence must be demonstrated.
permits.note: Verify if retained waters (within 300 ft of navigable waterway) require separate federal USACE jurisdiction

permits.name: FEMA LOMA/LOMR-F (Letter of Map Amendment/Revision Based on Fill)
permits.description: If fill raises lot above BFE, parcel can be removed from SFHA. Eliminates mandatory flood insurance and reduces construction cost premium.
permits.application_fee: No FEMA fee for LOMA; LOMR fees vary
prerequisites: Elevation Certificate showing lot above BFE
permits.note: Only viable if fill strategy is economically feasible and environmentally permissible

permits.name: FDEP Wellhead Protection Zone Approval
permits.description: Any development activity within wellhead protection zone (200-ft radius) must comply with FDEP regulations. Coordinate with Palm Bay Utilities for site-specific restrictions.
prerequisites: Coordination with Palm Bay Utilities (Tim Roberts)

permits.name: MTWCD Stormwater Discharge Permit
permits.description: Required for any stormwater discharge to MTWCD canals. Palm Bay Building Dept will NOT issue building permits without MTWCD clearance.

permits.name: Building Permit (Multifamily)
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Building Department
permits.description: Construction permit for multifamily building(s). Must comply with Florida Building Code 8th Edition, flood construction requirements, and ADA/FHA accessibility.
permits.estimated_fee: Based on construction value (typically 1-2% of construction cost)
prerequisites: Architectural drawings sealed by FL-licensed architect
Structural engineering sealed by FL PE

permits.name: Driveway/Access Permit
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Public Works
permits.description: Required for new driveway connection to Sandy Pines Drive. Maximum width 36 ft, angle as close to 90 degrees as practical.

permits.name: Utility Connection Permits (Water & Sewer)
permits.agency: City of Palm Bay — Utilities Department
permits.description: Permits for connecting to city water and sewer systems. May include sewer main extension permit if main does not reach parcel frontage.
permits.estimated_fee: Impact fees: $9,223 per ERC (water $3,553 + sewer $5,670). Plus connection fees.

permits.name: HOA Architectural Review Committee (ARC) Approval
permits.description: HOA CC&Rs almost certainly require ARC review and approval for any new construction. Must comply with community design standards, use restrictions, and CC&R provisions.
permits.critical_note: THIS IS THE MOST CRITICAL APPROVAL. If CC&Rs prohibit multifamily, this is a FATAL CONSTRAINT. Must obtain and review CC&Rs BEFORE any other permit applications.

permits.name: FWC Gopher Tortoise Relocation Permit (if applicable)
permits.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC)
permits.description: Required if gopher tortoise burrows found during 100% survey. Covers trapping, relocation, and recipient site.
permits.condition: Only if burrows found during pre-construction survey

activities: Pre-application meeting with Palm Bay Planning (Month 2)

permit_timeline_summary.total_estimated_months: 18-24 from project initiation to certificate of occupancy

critical_path_items.description: If CC&Rs prohibit multifamily, project cannot proceed as planned. Must be resolved FIRST.
critical_path_items.action: Obtain OR Book 3636/2327 from Brevard County Clerk

critical_path_items.description: Determines all development standards. Without it, no permit application can be prepared.
critical_path_items.action: Request from Palm Bay Land Development at (321) 733-3042

critical_path_items.description: 3-6 month review period. On the critical path for construction start.
critical_path_items.action: Begin consultant engagement as soon as CC&Rs and PUD are resolved

critical_path_items.description: Required before ERP application. 4-6 week field work + report.
critical_path_items.action: Commission immediately after CC&R go/no-go decision
